visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a bright professional studio/office. A woman wearing glasses and a beige sweater is positioned in the lower-right foreground. She points toward an inset video occupying the upper-left, which shows another woman with visible red marks on her face. The background contains a bookshelf with plaques and a computer monitor. Text overlays in Traditional Chinese appear at the bottom. (2) The scene transitions as the woman in the foreground continues to speak and gesture. The background remains the same. Graphic overlays of two circles showing skin textures appear centrally, labeled with text. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting her facial features and the studio environment. (3) A close-up series of images follows, showing skin with red spots and then skin with brownish scabs. Arrows and circles are drawn over these images in post-production to highlight specific areas. The woman in the foreground remains visible, interacting with these visual aids by pointing. (4) The woman in the foreground shows a picture of her own face with similar red spots to provide a personal example. She gestures toward her cheek. The environment is consistent, though the focus shifts entirely to the comparative images of post-treatment skin. (5) The final phase shows a white end screen with the clinic's logo, a stylized 'DR', contact information including a phone number and social media handles, and a map icon. The background is a clean white graphic with black and grey text.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Professional Explanation -> Personal Evidence -> Reassurance -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers about the normal post-operative reactions of laser treatment for freckles and sun spots. By reacting to a patient's concern over redness and showing her own recovery photos, the dermatologist reassures the audience that redness and scabbing are expected parts of the healing process rather than treatment failure.
